notes: The two branches («ح») meet at حيوة بن شريح; the names after it are written once and belong to both routes (shared tail)
«- قال سليمان عن أبي عبد الرحمن الخراساني -» names a different transmitter for the same saying: a variant group, not a route
«قال أبو داود الإخبار لجعفر وهذا لفظه» is the compiler's note that the wording follows Ja'far's branch; no transmitter, no group
«- ... -» dash glosses are otherwise left out
